title: Naming day and baby shower cakes for Parramatta, Granville and Westmead
summary:
A baby shower table gets checked twice in a South Asian household — once for taste, once for eggs. We removed the second check in 2019.

Every cake at Harris Park is 100% eggless — not the sponge, not the buttercream, not the ganache. Fifteen flavours, six sizes, any design. Vegetarian, Jain and halal-friendly guests eat the same slice as everyone else, no separate plate required.

Now serving naming days and baby showers across Parramatta, Granville and Westmead. 48 hours minimum notice. Pickup from Wigram Street, open until 10pm daily.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
